title: Purple Moon Sorceress
description: A female character with white hair in an ornate updo stands in a dynamic pose against a solid dark gray background. She wears purple and white traditional fantasy armor with lunar motifs, holding a glowing purple crescent moon in her right hand while her left hand projects a large swirling orb of purple cosmic energy containing crescent moons and stars.
